comparison.objective: Roll a shelf wider than a cabinet opening through the face frame, level it, and lower it onto four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Reorientation through a constrained opening, bimanual leveling, and four-support placement.
comparison.success_condition: Shelf rests on all four pins, level, square, fully back, stable for one second, with grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Tests collision-aware reorientation and multi-support placement. It does not require a continuously closed support seam or retention of independently mobile bearing elements.
